test_assert_eq: test that two values are equal using the assert_eq utility function
test_assert_neq: test that two values are not equal using the assert_neq utility function
test_assert_lt: test that a value is less than an expected threshold using assert_lt
test_assert_tensor_eq: test that two PyTorch tensors are approximately equal within a given epsilon tolerance
test_assert_zero_grad: test that all parameter gradients sum to zero using assert_zero_grad
